Lane cpu: the reader is local-store only and CPU-bound on the csv parse (the sidecar is parsed twice per capture, once by the reused M1 J0Pass), not an IO-wait job. mem_mb 450 is the instruction, NOT a measurement: the CH269 map peaked at 558.8 MB against a 450 spec and M1-J0 at 297.6 MB; the synthetic test peak says nothing about the host. The host dry run must confirm peak_rss_mb before the job is promoted, and the spec must be raised (not the reader trimmed) if it exceeds 450. The address-space cap is virtual memory (pyarrow, numpy). The spread-before / spread-after windows are the text's 10-13..10-19 and 10-21..10-29; they need the engine's quotes/ and features/ of those days to still be within the 45-day retention when the job runs (a missing capture is listed, never filled).
